blocking_defects.defect: In the selected B film the guest's hand changes skin tone across cuts within one ordering clause. Overhead at 15.6 to 19.0s it is brown. Eye level at 19.2 to 21.2s both the holding and tapping hands are light-skinned. At 21.8 to 22.4s a brown fingertip presses Pay. One guest's order appears to pass between two different people, which breaks the single-order throughline that 'A guest scans... taps... and pays' describes.

In B the same overhead table framing jumps. At 51.0s a hand holds the phone at the lower left edge. At 51.2s the hand is gone, the phone lies face up on the table at the right, and the QR stand has moved. This is an unmotivated disappearance and teleport of the subject, and it reads as a glitch rather than the lowered phone the clause needs.

In both films a large grey translucent rectangle appears on the ledger card rows as the $9,650 tag swings in (30.4 to 31.0s) and under the quote card as it slides in (51.4 to 51.8s), then disappears. At phone size it reads as an unfinished smudge or placeholder shadow on the evidence objects.
